EMCICalc-1.0.0-Desktop-Linux-desktop-dar.text: Expression editor: enter mathematics here, then press Enter or equals to confirm a result.
Calculation controls: check the angle convention and Exact/Decimal presentation before interpreting a result.
Memory strip: MS stores, MR recalls, M+ adds and MC clears the independent M memory.
Graph tabs: switch between Plot, Series, Range and Table to configure and inspect the workspace.
Settings gear: adjust appearance, input, calculation and saved-data preferences.
